Trust & Will review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: Popular online tool for US wills and trusts with guided questions. Not built for Australian or most non-US jurisdictions. Best for: US residents who want a straightforward will or trust online.

Key facts

  • Category: Estate & document tools
  • Pricing: One-off plan fees plus optional membership. Check current pricing.
  • Best for: US residents who want a straightforward will or trust online.
  • Guided, plain-English interview for wills and trusts
  • State-specific US documents

Official site / docs ↗

What are the pros and cons of Trust & Will?

Pros

  • Guided, plain-English interview for wills and trusts
  • State-specific US documents
  • Attorney-led plans for complex situations, plus an optional membership for updates

Cons

  • US-focused; not suitable for most other countries
  • Not a replacement for a lawyer in complex estates

Estate & document tools

GoodTrust

An all-in-one US estate planning platform: will, trust and directives (valid in all 50 states) plus a Digital Vault for your digital life.

Estate & document tools

Everplans

A well-structured digital vault for life admin and end-of-life plans that you can securely share with people you trust.

Estate & document tools

Prisidio

A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR.
